csv_project_name: Feasibility Study for STH 175N Lisbon Avenue Improvements
csv_agency: State of Wisconsin Dept of Trans Div Of Hwys
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Wisconsin , Department of Transportation , may be seeking a Consultant to Provide Feasibility Study for The Stadium freeway and the portion of Lisbon Avenue west of the Stadium Freeway are part of the state highway network and designated as WIS 175. The purpose of this feasibility study is to continue to develop, evaluate and refine concept alternatives developed in the Reimaging WIS 175 Study. This effort will continue to develop a contextually sensitive solution to the current configuration of the Stadium Freeway, limits from the I-94 Stadium Interchange to Lisbon Avenue and to develop alternatives that consider connectivity and future land use options. The study will continue the discussion on potential future improvements between the City of Milwaukee, Milwaukee County and Wisconsin Department of Transportation (WisDOT). The study will continue to evaluate: 1) mobility, 2) access, 3) safety, 4) environmental impacts, 5) congestion; partnering with the city and county on 6) economic development, 7) quality of life, and 8) community engagement.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Feasibility Studies, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Traffic Design Engineering

title: Feasibility Study for STH 175N Lisbon Avenue Improvements
short_description: Feasibility study for highway corridor improvements and redevelopment alternatives in Milwaukee.
project_scope: Feasibility study for WIS 175 including the Stadium Freeway corridor from the I-94 Stadium Interchange to Lisbon Avenue and the portion of Lisbon Avenue west of the Stadium Freeway. The study will further develop, evaluate, and refine concept alternatives from the Reimagining WIS 175 Study, focusing on a context-sensitive solution, corridor connectivity, and future land use options. Evaluation topics include mobility, access, safety, environmental impacts, congestion, economic development, quality of life, and community engagement.
services: Consulting services for feasibility study, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, land use planning, planning/master planning, environmental engineering/planning/design, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a feasibility and corridor planning study, not structural design.
- Focus is on highway planning, land use, traffic, environment, and community engagement.
- No bridge, roof, special structure, or building design component is identified.
- Matches sbp exclusion tendencies for pure planning/feasibility-oriented assignments.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. The procurement is only for a feasibility study of highway corridor improvements, so no realistic construction cost estimate can be derived from the provided information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. As this is only an advance notice for consultant services, there is no explicit basis to determine an sbp fee from the source.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested: civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, feasibility studies, land use planning, planning/master planning, environmental engineering/planning/design, and traffic design engineering. No specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the notice.
contracting_authority: State of Wisconsin Department of Transportation, Division of Highways, Agency ID 33439, Wisconsin, USA. Website: https://wisconsindot.gov/Pages/doing-bus/eng-consultants/solicitations/default.aspx
notes: Advance notice only. Solicitation ID: SE-01-. Project No: 1350-05-02. RFQ/RFP expected before 2026-06-01. Source explicitly requests no phone calls, no faxes, and no agency contact at this time. Although categorized here under Road Bridges due to the fixed output categories, the notice is actually a highway corridor feasibility study rather than a bridge project.
